scripts.build: node scripts/nx.mjs run-many -t build -p paintwarden paintwarden-site && node scripts/copy-third-party-notices.mjs apps/paintwarden-web/dist apps/paintwarden-site/dist apps/paintwarden/dist/web-dist
scripts.test: npm run test:graphql && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && node scripts/nx.mjs run-many -t test -p paintwarden @paintwarden/core @paintwarden/ui && npm run test --workspace paintwarden-electron
scripts.lint: npm run lint:eslint && npm run typecheck
scripts.lint:eslint: node scripts/nx.mjs run-many -t code-lint -p paintwarden paintwarden-web paintwarden-site @paintwarden/core @paintwarden/ui --parallel=2
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:shared && node --check apps/paintwarden-electron/main.cjs && node --check apps/paintwarden-electron/preload.cjs && node --check apps/paintwarden-electron/desktop-core.cjs
scripts.typecheck:shared: node scripts/nx.mjs run-many -t lint -p paintwarden paintwarden-web paintwarden-site && node scripts/nx.mjs run-many -t typecheck -p @paintwarden/core @paintwarden/ui
scripts.desktop: npm run build && node scripts/package-desktop-server.mjs electron && npm run start --workspace paintwarden-electron
scripts.desktop:package: npm run build && node scripts/package-desktop-server.mjs electron && npm run dist --workspace paintwarden-electron
scripts.codegen:check: npm run codegen && git diff --exit-code -- apps/paintwarden/graphql/generated packages/vault-ui/src/dom/graphql/generated
scripts.test:graphql: npm run test:graphql --workspace paintwarden && node --import tsx --test packages/vault-ui/src/dom/graphql/*.test.ts
